Lydia / Rachel — following up with the commercial mechanics so we can lock Net 45: 

- Discount and commit: To offer Net 45 we require either (A) a 6-month committed minimum spend of $85k/month, or (B) a 12-month commit at 20% prepayment. If NextWave prefers no prepay, option A is the path.
- Packaging: The committed capacity can be structured as reserved GPU hours (Dedicated) or a committed monthly MLU (model load units) that maps to token throughput. We'll reflect either into the Pricing Worksheet depending on which your infra team prefers.
- Invoice cadence: We will support monthly invoices and can split the first quarter (two invoices) as requested. GL code field will be on each invoice line; please provide the exact GL codes.

If you can confirm which commit option you prefer, I’ll generate a redlined quote and issue a DocuSign packet.
